scripts.dev: npm run build -w @spf/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @spf/server" "npm run dev -w @spf/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @spf/shared && npm run build -w @spf/server && npm run build -w @spf/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @spf/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --project tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @spf/shared && npm run db:migrate -w @spf/server
scripts.db:bootstrap: npm run build -w @spf/shared && npm run db:bootstrap -w @spf/server
scripts.db:create-account: npm run build -w @spf/shared && npm run db:create-account -w @spf/server
scripts.db:seed-accounts: npm run build -w @spf/shared && npm run db:seed-accounts -w @spf/server
scripts.db:export: npm run build -w @spf/shared && npm run db:export -w @spf/server
scripts.db:restore: npm run build -w @spf/shared && npm run db:restore -w @spf/server
scripts.legacy:export: npm run build -w @spf/shared && npm run legacy:export -w @spf/server
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:reset-password: npm run build -w @spf/shared && npm run db:reset-password -w @spf/server
